verdict.rationale: The DOS site states that a form and instructions for the Certificate of Incorporation may be obtained from the Department of State website. The publicly fetched certificate page carries form-specific guidance ("You are not required to use this form", editing the stock statement) and references a downloadable Credit Card Authorization Form, all on public pages rather than behind the blocked filing app. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or hands-on confirmation that the PDF forms download without any account, direct evidence of the actual download links, and independent corroboration.
